FormModule.Name: VDICODES
FormModule.Comment:
module modified by Simon using JDAPI_LAF on Thursday 14 August 2008 17:17:27This is the maintenance screen for valid_master_codes table. Unlike its previous version, this table maintains a index of various code types' that are defined by users. All code types' are stored as a codes for a meta code type 'CODTP'.
Hence user cannot use this as a code type for the purpose of creating codes.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** validate value entered in code type field;
** if it is a valid value, display it's description, 
** else show alert box and ask user confirmation.
** if user enters a null value in this field, show the 
** master list of code types to the user.
*/

declare
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button Number; 
begin
 if :ctrl_block.code_type is null then
 :ctrl_block.code_type := 'CODTP'; 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 begin
 select description, eff_date, nvl(term_date, '')
 into :ctrl_block.code_type_description, :ctrl_block.eff_date, :ctrl_block.term_date
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'CODTP'
 and code = :ctrl_block.code_type
 and (term_date is null or
 term_date > sysdate);

 :ctrl_block.code_type_status := 'EXISTING';

 exception
 when no_data_found then
 al_id := Find_Alert('new_code_type_Alert');
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id );
 set_alert_property(al_id, title, 'New Code Type?');
 set_alert_property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Do you wish to create new code type?');
 set_alert_button_property(al_id, alert_button1, label, 'Yes');
 set_alert_button_property(al_id, alert_button2, label, 'No');

 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 :ctrl_block.code_type_status := 'NEW';
 :ctrl_block.code_type_description := '';
 else
 :ctrl_block.code_type := '';
 :ctrl_block.code_type_description := '';
 message ('Err: Enter unique code type, or use LISTVAL.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
end;

/*
** eff_date for the code type cannot be null.
*/

declare
 h_min_date date ;

begin
 /*
 ** check if eff date is null
 */
 if :ctrl_block.eff_date is null then
-- message ('Err: Enter effective date, format MM-DD-YY.');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 /*
 ** check if code eff_date > code term_date 
 */
 if :ctrl_block.term_date is not null then
 if :ctrl_block.eff_date > :ctrl_block.term_date then
-- message ('Err: Code type is terminated before it is made effective.');
 show_error('11013');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;

 /*
 ** for eff date of a code_type, if eff_date is changed, then we should
 ** check it against eff_date for all it's codes' eff_date for chronological
 ** order.
 */
 begin
 select min(eff_date) 
 into h_min_date
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = :ctrl_block.code_type;

 if :ctrl_block.eff_date > h_min_date then
-- message ('Err: Effective date for some codes for this code type, precede effective date for the code type.');
 show_error('9305');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;

 end;
 
exception
 when value_error then
 show_error('0022');
 check_package_failure;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DUPL_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_dupl_value
 (which_block IN VARCHAR2, -- which block to check
 which_field IN VARCHAR2, -- which column to check
 check_value IN VARCHAR2, -- for which value
 curr_record IN VARCHAR2, -- current record number
 dup_found OUT VARCHAR2 -- set to TRUE or FALSE
 ) IS
BEGIN
 /*
 ** we check for 'which_value', in 'which_field' of 'which_block' in the current form.
 ** if the value is found, we return TRUE else we return FALSE in all other cases we
 ** return 'ERROR' to indicate anything going wrong.
 */

 go_block(which_block);
 go_record(1);

 while (:system.last_record = 'FALSE')
 loop
 if :system.cursor_record != curr_record and 
 name_in(which_field) = check_value then
 dup_found := 'TRUE';
 return;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;

 dup_found := 'FALSE';
 return;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 then

 elsif error_code = 41830 --list values contains no entries
 then

 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');

 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 41800 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 41008 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 ---------- Following added by Mukesh 05/28 --------------
 elsif error_code = 41009 --Function key not allowed
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 41051 --Can not create records here
 then
 show_error('12038');
 ----------------------------------------------------------
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026)
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in ('0','40209') -- invalid format
 then
 format_error;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
